    """Fetch the given URL, retrying on timeouts.

    Calls ``_get(url, timeout)`` up to ``retries`` times. Only ``TimeoutError``
    triggers a retry; any other exception propagates immediately. If the final
    attempt times out, the ``TimeoutError`` is re-raised.

    Args:
        url: The URL to fetch.
        retries: Maximum number of attempts. Defaults to 3.
        timeout: Timeout in seconds for each attempt. Defaults to 10.0.

    Returns:
        The value returned by ``_get`` on the first successful attempt.
        If ``retries`` is 0 or less, the loop does not run and ``None`` is returned.

    Raises:
        TimeoutError: If every attempt times out.
    """
